typeDescription: Different types: left is {{leftType}}, right is {{rightType}}
rulesHint: View current JSON comparison rules and known limitations
rulesDescription: Comparison uses parsed JSON structures and values. These rules and limitations affect the results.

structure.title: Formatting and object key order are ignored
structure.description: Indentation, line breaks, whitespace outside strings, and object key order do not affect results. Objects are compared recursively by key; result views sort object keys by name.

numbers.title: Numbers are compared by value
numbers.description: 1, 1.0, and 1e0 are equal, as are 0 and -0. Parsing does not preserve the original number notation.

types.title: Types are compared strictly
types.description: The number 1 differs from the string "1". Null, objects, arrays, strings, numbers, and booleans have distinct types. A type change stops comparison inside that node.

arrays.title: Arrays are compared by index
arrays.description: Array order matters. Moves and object matching by id are not detected. For example, [1,2,3] versus [0,1,2,3] produces three value changes and one addition, rather than a single insertion at the start.

strings.title: Strings are compared after parsing
strings.description: "a" and "\u0061" are equal. Spaces, line breaks, and case within strings matter. Unicode normalization is not applied.

missing.title: Missing values differ from empty values
missing.description: A missing property, null, an empty string, {}, and [] are distinct. Items only on the right are added; items only on the left are removed.

counting.title: Whole nodes count as one difference
counting.description: Adding or removing an entire object or array, or changing a node’s type, counts as one difference. Its contents are not counted individually.

syntax.title: Only standard JSON is accepted
syntax.description: Empty or invalid input stops the comparison. Comments, trailing commas, single quotes, undefined, NaN, and other extensions are not accepted. Input is not automatically repaired.

precision.title: Number precision and range
precision.description: Integers outside the safe range (±9007199254740991) may lose precision. For example, 9007199254740992 and 9007199254740993 may compare as equal. Very large exponents such as 1e400 may overflow; no additional protection is applied.

duplicates.title: Duplicate keys keep only the last value
duplicates.description: Parsing overwrites earlier values for duplicate keys within an object. Duplicate keys are not reported, and overwritten values cannot be compared.

paths.title: Special keys may affect navigation
paths.description: Empty keys, keys containing /, or keys resembling array indices (such as [0]) may cause path collisions and inaccurate highlighting, summary paths, or navigation.

display.title: Some edge cases have incomplete display
display.description: When the root type changes, child lines may not all be highlighted. Some uncommon control characters in strings are not fully escaped and may display inaccurately.

size.title: Large or deeply nested data
size.description: Comparison and rendering run synchronously on the page. Large or deeply nested JSON may cause slowdowns or comparison failures.
